summary: Web terminals render raw PTY output with in-browser Ghostty and type directly, retaining ordered gateway input when raw attachment is unavailable

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection change.

schema.detail: No schema, index or trigger changes.

rules.detail: Server authorization is unchanged. terminal.control permits raw ATTACH; read-only devices use PEEK admitted with terminal.read. The terminal.input action also requires terminal.control, so limited pairings remain read-only. Gateway input preserves typing for authorized devices after raw attachment fails.

compatibility.detail: Visible terminal panes use st3.client.pty.v0 WebSockets for output. ATTACH sends typing, paste and element-driven size votes; PEEK sends no DATA, RESIZE or RESET, and renews its selected-use lease only while the pane and page are foreground-selected. Failed ATTACH falls back to PEEK and ordered gateway input, while failed PEEK or emulator loading falls back to the projected screen. Explicit gateway resize remains available without ATTACH. The keyboard strip is replaced by direct terminal focus. Hidden or unloaded pages synchronously release writable attachments and their size votes, close input sessions and drop queued keys; restored focus alone cannot rearm typing, which requires a fresh user gesture.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart or deploy drops the socket; the pane reconnects with a fresh capability, replays the current screen, and never replays keys typed while disconnected.

manual.detail: No operator action. Devices paired with limited scopes stay read-only until their pairing admits `terminal.control`.

recovery.detail: No new persistent state. Reverting the web client restores the projected view and keyboard strip.
